column1: # The top-starred Kotlin projects the corpus builds, and Now in Android as the Android sample, one
# The Kotlin version pin names the file and key that select the project's Kotlin Gradle plugin;
# run.sh rewrites it to the newest release in the repository's `kotlin-versions` manifest. "-" means
# the project already builds with that release. A patches/<name>.patch is applied after checkout.
# Android modules are compared only for a project that names a variant: its main, unit-test and
# instrumented-test compiles. Without one ("-" or no column) Android modules are left out.
